title: Leisure
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child describes Genesis 2:1-3 (God finished his work, rested on the seventh day, blessed it and made it holy) and 1 Timothy 5:13 (idleness leads to gossip and meddling), and says good rest refreshes and honours God.

floor.question: What work did God give Adam in Genesis 2:15?
floor.answer: To work the garden and take care of it

representations: a seven-day strip with the seventh marked
steps: The seventh: God rested, blessed it, made it holy.
contexts: a holiday spent only on a phone

board.do: Draw seven boxes for the days of creation.

board.say: What did God do on this day, and why?

board.do: Wait for the child to say rested because his work was finished, and made it holy.

misconceptions.ask: Why did God rest on the seventh day (Genesis 2:2-3)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 2:2-3: God finished, blessed and made holy. Ask whether God gets tired (Isaiah 40:28).
Contrast rest that refreshes with idleness that leads to gossip (1 Timothy 5:13).

misconceptions.ask: On which day did God rest (Genesis 2:2)?
misconceptions.repair: Count the days on the fingers: six of creating, the seventh of rest.

listen_for: Yes, he left the world alone
misconceptions.ask: After God rested on the seventh day, did he stop caring for the world?
misconceptions.repair: Read Psalm 121:4: he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep. God rested from creating, not from caring.

checks.question: On which day did God rest?
What does 1 Timothy 5:13 warn against?
checks.answer: Idleness that leads to gossip and meddling

skills.key_step: The child describes how youths misuse leisure (drugs, gambling, idleness, too much screen time, bad company) and names good uses and the values that help (self-control, responsibility, time management).

floor.prerequisite: Knows God's rest and the warning against idleness.
floor.question: What does 1 Timothy 5:13 warn against?

representations: a day drawn as a pie chart
two columns: builds up, pulls down
contexts: a betting shop near the estate

board.do: Draw two columns: builds up and pulls down.
Point at the card "betting with friends".
Wait for the child to say pulls down.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a good use of free time?
misconceptions.repair: Sort cards into builds up and pulls down, and name the harm of each misuse.

misconceptions.ask: Which value helps a youth use leisure well?
misconceptions.repair: Name values: self-control, responsibility, time management. Ask what each looks like on a Saturday.

misconceptions.ask: Halima spends every day of the holiday on her phone from morning to night. Is this good use of leisure?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a day as a pie: sleep, chores, family, play, reading, screen. What happens if screen fills it?

misconceptions.ask: Which of these is a good use of leisure?
misconceptions.repair: List leisure activities in four groups: rest, play, learn, serve. All can be good.

checks.question: Which is a good use of free time: gambling or reading?
Which value helps a youth use leisure well?
